errors.description: contributor is missing, malformed, or not a contributor record URI; or sort, order, limit or language is outside the accepted range.
errors.name: InvalidRequest

errors.description: No catalog contributor has that URI.
errors.name: RecordNotFound

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; absent when no more editions are credited.

items.description: Editions credited to the contributor, newest catalog creation first unless `sort` says otherwise. An edition in which the contributor holds several roles appears once.

total.description: Total credited editions matching the request's filters. Present on the first page only.

contributor.description: AT-URI of a net.olamaelcu.livtet.biblio.contributor record. A URI from another collection is rejected rather than looked up.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response. A malformed cursor restarts at the beginning rather than erroring.

language.description: Only editions whose published shape claims this language. Matched on the primary subtag, case-insensitively, so `en` matches `en` and `en-US`.

limit.description: Maximum number of editions to return.

order.description: Direction for a `title` or `publishedYear` sort. Ignored when `sort` is `relevance`, whose order is newest-first.

sort.description: Ordering of the page. `title` is alphabetical by edition title; `publishedYear` orders by the edition's published date, and an edition with no usable year sorts last. `relevance` keeps this method's own order: newest catalog creation first.

description: List every catalog edition credited to one contributor, across all credited roles. Anonymous and read-only; served by the bibliograph edge from the catalog tables.
